toegepas.voor: Gesinne by hul huise en groepe bure in gemeenskapstuine kry so vars kos
toegepas.na: So kry gesinne by hul huise en groepe bure in gemeenskapstuine vars kos
toegepas.rede_vinder: The long subject delays the verb and buries 'so'; fronting 'So kry' links the sentence to the one before and reads more naturally, with no change in words or meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'kry so vars kos' first reads as 'such fresh food' (so vars), and the long subject delays the verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Fronting 'So kry' removes the 'so vars' misreading, keeps every word and the meaning, and links back to the previous sentence.

toegepas.voor: Van mielies maak ons pap en van koring
toegepas.na: Van mielies maak ons pap, en van koring
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (ons maak).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses (ons maak ... ons maak).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each half has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.voor: Van suikerriet kry ons suiker en van sonneblomme
toegepas.na: Van suikerriet kry ons suiker, en van sonneblomme
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (ons kry).
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses (ons kry ... ons kry).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each half has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma before 'en'.

toegepas.voor: om klere en lap van te maak
toegepas.na: om klere en lap daarvan te maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: The stranded 'van' has no clear antecedent in this purpose clause; 'daarvan' refers clearly back to katoen.
toegepas.fout: Stranded 'van' in an adverbial purpose clause has no object to attach to.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daarvan' points clearly back to katoen, adds no word, and leaves the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A list of three actions takes commas, not a repeated 'en'; the protected 'Die meeste avokado's' is untouched.
toegepas.fout: Repeated 'en ... en' in a three-part list reads clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain comma list is the natural form, saves a word, and leaves the protected 'Die meeste avokado's' intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Dried fruit as a product is the compound 'droëvrugte'; written apart it means fruit that is dry, and the change saves a word.
toegepas.fout: The product 'dried fruit' is the compound 'droëvrugte'; written apart it is a spelling error.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Correct compound spelling for the product, same meaning, one word fewer.

na_skrywer.voor: Boerdery waar die boer gewasse of diere produseer
na_skrywer.na: Boerdery waar 'n boer gewasse of diere produseer
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A glossary entry is read on its own, so the definite 'die boer' has no antecedent; the indefinite article fits a definition.
na_skrywer.fout: The definition uses 'die boer' with no antecedent, unlike the parallel entry's ''n familie'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition, and only the writer may change one, so it goes to the writer as a flag.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Vir die gesin of vir die winkel
vlae.rede: The comparative 'kleiner' compares with farms not yet named, and the same block later says farm size is not the real difference; changing it to 'klein' would harden it into an absolute claim, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge rather than changed.
